about: Shared synthetic adversarial vectors for the MCP privacy layer (S37fix). Read by tests/test_mcp_privacy_vectors.py (Python) and packages/mcp/src/privacy/sharedVectors.test.ts (TypeScript). Everything is invented: the Visa test card 4532 0151 1283 0366, the textbook IBAN PL61 1090 1014 0000 0712 1981 2874 and the names Anna Nowak / Jan Kowalski. 'absent': substrings the redacted text must not contain; 'expect': the exact text per mode; 'guard': scrub with the name guard; 'authored': agent / cashU text (R3, R4) with the owner-text result; 'symbols_known': symbol fields against the guard's known digit-only symbols (R5). 'expressions': strict custom conditions (S37fix3 E1 / E2 / E4) with the exact strict text; 'messages': strict system messages (scrub_numbers, S37fix3 E2).
